note: The description comes from the Diagnostic characters of the entry 25. Microcerotermes dumasensis Thakur in State Fauna Series 8: Fauna of Gujarat, Insecta: Isoptera, covering the soldier and the worker; the distribution records only the type locality Gujarat: Dumas. The upper limit of the soldier head length including the mandibles, 1.81—2.94 mm, is inconsistent with the head length without the mandibles, 1.75—1.88 mm, and is suspected to be an OCR misreading; it is copied as in the original without change.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale brown, mandibles dark brown. Body length 5.29—5.44 mm; head length including the mandibles 1.81—2.94 mm, without the mandibles 1.75—1.88 mm, greatest head width 0.94—1.06 mm. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 1 longest, segment 3 shortest, the terminal segment (the 13th) oval. Mandibles stout; left and right mandible greatest length 1.0—1.06 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, 0.38—0.44 mm long, 0.66—0.69 mm wide. Legs hairy, tibial spur formula 3:2:2; the mid tibia with 2 additional spines. Abdomen elongate, cerci 2-segmented.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule cream yellow, densely hairy, nearly square. Body length 4.48—4.59 mm. Head length (to the lateral mandible base) 0.98—1.05 mm, greatest head width 0.77—0.84 mm. Antennae 13-segmented, hairy, segment 1 longest, segment 3 shortest, the terminal segment (the 13th) oval. Mandibles with 1 apical and 2 marginal teeth, with a basal projection. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin convex with a weak median notch. Legs hairy; tibial spur formula 3:2:2. Abdomen elongate and hairy, cerci 2-segmented.
